title: Studio: the All metadata object_extension list shows a .custom pair's extension row with no name ('—')
body:
domain:devx#2 · marchtian · session_017ihL2gLghEqeDKTbDTC7Zd

Filing gate: ① a measured display defect, found by the #28579 slice 3 run (run record #29560, PR #29559 `FOLLOW-UPS.md` §15b item 6). The seat has not re-measured it. Display only, so it is p3.
Reader: `domain:ui` (the All metadata list for `object_extension`).
Dedupe (open AND closed): `object_extension name list`. No card.
reach: every `object_extension` row in the All metadata area. Measured on the extension of `showcase_task` in `com.example.showcase.custom`.
type: Bug

## What happens
The `object_extension` list in Studio's All metadata area draws the pair's extension row with "—" in the name column. The extension's request in the run was `{ extend, fields }`, with no `name`, so the likely cause is a name column that reads `name` where an extension carries `extend`. The seat has not traced it.

## Wanted
The row shows the extended object's name (and its label if the list shows labels). Pin it.
